episodes.title: Coasts
episodes.summary: A pregnant Tuarangisaurus is in distress—and her young calf can sense it—as she travels waters that are home to the ocean's deadliest predators.

episodes.title: Deserts
episodes.summary: Above the deserts of North Africa, aerial combat ensues as male Barbaridactylus pterosaurs fight for the attention of females below.

episodes.title: Freshwater
episodes.summary: With its feathered body and duck bill, the eight-ton Deinocheirus wades through an Asian wetland in search of relief from pesky biting flies.

episodes.title: Ice Worlds
episodes.summary: Within the snow-covered forest, a tense standoff develops between ancient rivals, Pachyrhinosaurus and Nanuqsaurus.

episodes.title: Forests
episodes.summary: A journey through an underground cave in North America turns perilous when a young Triceratops is separated from its mother.

episodes.title: Islands
episodes.summary: On a small island, a monumental display takes place as the giant Hatzegopteryx reveals his gentler side to woo a mate.

episodes.title: Badlands
episodes.summary: Trudging through a scorching desert, two young Tarchia find relief at an oasis and encounter an adult twice their size, ready to lay claim.

episodes.title: Swamps
episodes.summary: In a drought-stricken basin where much has perished, an old Pachycephalosaurus bull defends his leadership against a young challenger.

episodes.title: Oceans
episodes.summary: Deep beneath the water's surface, the world's largest predator—the Mosasaurus—lies in wait to ambush unsuspecting prey.

episodes.title: North America
episodes.summary: Not many can intimidate North America's top predator, T. rex, whose size and bite are a deadly combo—except for a giant winged foe.

episodes.title: The Big Freeze
episodes.summary: In a world covered in ice, woolly mammoths and saber-toothed cats fight to survive the coldest temperatures in millions of years.

episodes.title: New Lands
episodes.summary: As sea levels drop and continents shift, animals begin migrating to unknown territories full of new possibilities — and new threats.

episodes.title: Desert Lands
episodes.summary: With much of the planet's water supply frozen, rock-climbing sloths and marsupial lions must find a way to withstand barren landscapes.

episodes.title: Grass Lands
episodes.summary: Giant herd animals thrive with the expansion of the grasslands, dominating the plains — but fearsome hunters shadow their every move.

episodes.title: The Big Melt
episodes.summary: Season finale. Rising temperatures mean every habitat on the planet is transforming, and for the Goliaths of the Ice Age, the world as they know it is ending.
